import os
import sys

# Locate the docx skill root so the Document library can be imported
skill_root = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '.codex', 'skills', 'docx')
sys.path.insert(0, skill_root)

from scripts.document import Document

RPR = ('<w:rPr>'
       '<w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" w:cs="Helvetica Light"/>'
       '<w:sz w:val="24"/>'
       '<w:sz-cs w:val="24"/>'
       '</w:rPr>')


def para(text):
    return ('<w:p><w:pPr/>'
            f'<w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r>'
            '</w:p>')


def blank_para():
    return ('<w:p><w:pPr/>'
            f'<w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space="preserve"/></w:r>'
            '</w:p>')


doc = Document('unpacked')
body = doc['word/document.xml']

# Locate the final content paragraph (RISK FACTORS body) to insert after it
anchor = body.get_node(tag='w:p', contains='Key risks include')

recommendations = (
    blank_para()
    + para('RECOMMENDATIONS')
    + blank_para()
    + para('Based on Q4 2024 results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management '
           'recommends the following actions:')
    + blank_para()
    + para('• Increase investment in Cloud Services to sustain 20%+ revenue growth')
    + para('• Expand into two additional international markets by Q3 2025')
    + para('• Maintain R&D spending at or above 12% of revenue to support new product launches')
    + para('• Continue the share repurchase program funded by operating cash flow')
)

body.insert_after(anchor, recommendations)
doc.save()
print('Recommendation section added successfully.')

import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.document import Document, DocxXMLEditor

RSID = "59B3D309"

doc = Document("unpacked_quarterly_report", rsid=RSID, track_revisions=True,
               author="Claude", initials="C")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

risk_para = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include")

rpr = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" w:cs="Helvetica Light"/>'
       '<w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')


def spacer():
    return f'<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>{rpr}<w:t xml:space="preserve"/></w:r></w:p>'


def content_para(text):
    return f'<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>{rpr}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'


# Content paragraphs are tracked insertions (business-document redlining workflow)
header = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(content_para("RECOMMENDATIONS"))
intro = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(content_para(
    "Based on Q4 2024 results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management recommends the following actions:"))
bullets = [
    DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(content_para(
        "\u2022 Prioritize capacity and sales investments in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing "
        "segment (+22.8% YoY), to sustain momentum into 2025.")),
    DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(content_para(
        "\u2022 Extend the 8.3% reduction in customer acquisition costs by scaling successful "
        "marketing campaigns across all segments.")),
    DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(content_para(
        "\u2022 Maintain R&D investment levels to support the new product launches expected to "
        "drive 10-13% revenue growth in Q1 2025.")),
    DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(content_para(
        "\u2022 Accelerate international expansion while retaining the hedging strategies that "
        "protect against currency fluctuations.")),
]
closing = DocxXMLEditor.suggest_paragraph(content_para(
    "These actions are intended to preserve operating margins above 22% and deliver sustained "
    "value through 2025."))

section_xml = (spacer() + spacer() + header + spacer() + intro
               + "".join(bullets) + closing)
editor.insert_after(risk_para, section_xml)
doc.save()
print("Recommendations section added.")
